Title: Announcing Azure Private Link GA for Azure Services

Body.Content:
Azure Private Link is now generally available (GA) for the below services:

  • Azure Storage
  • Azure Data Lake Storage Gen 2
  • Azure SQL Database
  • Azure Cosmos DB
  • Azure Synapse Analytics (SQL Data Warehouse)
  • Azure Key Vault
  • Azure Database for MySQL
  • Azure Database for PostgreSQL
  • Azure Database for MariaDB
  • Azure Kubernetes Service -> Kubernetes API

In addition, Private Link is now available in preview for the following services:

  • App Service
  • Azure Cognitive Search
  • Event Hub
  • Service Bus
  • Azure Relay
  • Azure Backup
  • Azure Container Registry
  • Event Grid -> Topics
  • Event Grid -> Domains

For complete details on the services available in GA or Preview including available locations: Learn more.

Get started with these tutorials: Portal, PowerShell, CLI, concepts and recommendations about Private Endpoints: Learn more.
